label: TikTok One (Creator Marketplace)
terms_note: API access needs an approved TikTok for Business developer app and the Creator Marketplace permission (docs portal); ToS not read this session

discovery.auth: oauth2 (TikTok Marketing API developer app + advertiser / TTO authorization; Access-Token)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (read endpoints for TTO Creator Marketplace campaigns inside the Marketing API v1.3) Confidence: **medium**.
auth: 1. TikTok Marketing API developer app + TTO scope (see tiktok.md).

fields.name: access_token
fields.help: Access token authorized by a TikTok One Creator Marketplace account (auth_code exchanged at /oauth2/access_token/); it does not expire unless the account revokes it (https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/obtain-authorization-and-authentication-from-a-tto-creator-marketplace-account/v1.3).

fields.name: app_secret
fields.help: Secret of your TikTok for Business developer app, needed by the account-listing call used by me.

config_fields.name: app_id
config_fields.help: App ID of your TikTok for Business developer app (My Apps > App Detail > Basic Information).

me.note: GET /tto/oauth2/tcm/?app_id&secret: {data: {tto_tcm_account_ids: [...]}}, the TTO Creator Marketplace accounts that authorised the app (use one as account_id).

list_campaigns.note: GET /tto/tcm/campaign/?tto_tcm_account_id={account_id} (page_size at most 5). These are creator-collaboration campaigns (brand, creators invited, video ids), not paid ad campaigns: there is no budget or delivery status.

not_offered.list_accounts: The account listing "GET /tto/oauth2/tcm/" returns a bare array of id strings (data.tto_tcm_account_ids, https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693478150146), which the adapter cannot map to account records; me returns it.
not_offered.get_report: TTO Creator Marketplace reports are video-level per campaign and region ("/tto/tcm/report/" with a Country-Code header, https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693573340162), not campaign spend over a date range.
not_offered.update_budget: TTO Creator Marketplace campaigns have no budget field (https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-tto-creator-marketplace-campaigns/v1.3); paid delivery is managed through the TikTok Ads API (the `tiktok` entry).
not_offered.pause_resume: TTO Creator Marketplace campaigns have no pause/resume status (https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-tto-creator-marketplace-campaigns/v1.3).

evidence: host business-api.tiktok.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 2/2 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 308 (redirect), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 2/2 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; names not found on the page: me:app_id, me:secret
